title_en: Guiding Case No. 225: Jiang — justifiable defense case
ruling_gist_en:
1. For distinguishing between defensive acts and mutual fighting arising from student bullying, the principle of integrating subjective and objective elements should be adhered to. By comprehensively considering factors such as the cause of the incident, whether the actor was primarily at fault, whether others were instigated to participate in the fight, and by taking into account the possible reactions of minors of the same age group in similar situations, the actor's subjective intent and the nature of the act should be accurately determined. The determination of defensive intent should not be affected merely because the actor refused to show weakness when facing bullying or used tools to counterattack.

2. As to whether the defense "clearly exceeds the necessary limits", it should be based on the specific circumstances at the time of defense, from the perspective of the general cognition of minors of the same age group, comprehensively considering the nature, means, intensity, and harmful consequences of the unlawful infringement in student bullying, as well as the timing, means, intensity, and harmful consequences of the defense, and taking into account the balance of power between the two sides, to make a reasonable judgment.

full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 225: Jiang — justifiable defense case

(Adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, released on May 30, 2024)

Keywords

Criminal / justifiable defense / minor / student bullying / defensive intent / limitation of defense

Ruling Gist

1. In distinguishing between defensive acts arising from student bullying and mutual fighting, the principle of integrating subjective and objective elements shall be adhered to. A comprehensive assessment shall be made of the cause of the incident, whether the actor was primarily at fault, whether others were instigated to participate in the fight, and other circumstances, combined with the possible reactions of minors of the same age group in similar situations, to accurately determine the actor's subjective intent and the nature of the act. The determination of defensive intent shall not be affected solely on the basis that the actor did not show weakness when facing bullying or used tools to fight back.

2. Whether the defense "clearly exceeded the necessary limits" shall be determined based on the specific circumstances at the time of defense, from the perspective of the general cognition of minors of the same age group, comprehensively considering the nature, means, intensity, and harmful consequences of the unlawful infringement in student bullying, as well as the timing, means, intensity, and harmful consequences of the defense, and taking into account the balance of power between the two sides, to make a reasonable judgment.

Basic Facts

The defendant, Jiang (a pseudonym, aged 14 at the time), was a second-year junior high school student at a middle school in Hunan Province. During a spring outing, Jiang chatted with a female classmate. Hu, a student from a neighboring class in the same grade, believed that Jiang was flirting with his girlfriend and demanded that Jiang buy cigarettes as an apology, otherwise he would beat Jiang. Subsequently, Jiang bought a pack of cigarettes for Hu, but Hu disliked the brand and refused to accept them, thus forming the intention to beat Jiang.

Before morning self-study on May 17, 2019, Sun, a classmate who had a conflict with Jiang, together with others, called Jiang to the restroom on a pretext and threatened to beat him. Jiang responded with words showing no weakness (later explained as a delay tactic, intending to run away after school). After morning self-study ended, when Jiang went to the restroom, Sun, Hu, and others pulled Jiang and kicked him. They then dispersed when class began. After the second period, Sun invited classmates Zhang, Hu, and others to help beat Jiang, and pointed out Jiang, who was in the restroom, to Zhang.

After lunch, Sun again invited the victims Chen A, Chen B, Wu, and others to help beat Jiang. Subsequently, Sun and seven others went to the classroom to find Jiang, while the other eight waited in the restroom. Jiang refused to go, but Sun threatened to forcibly take him away. Jiang was forced to follow, hiding a multi-purpose folding knife (not a controlled knife, blade length approximately 4.5 centimeters) used to open medicine bottles in the right sleeve of his uniform. Upon arriving at the restroom, Sun, Hu, Zhang, and the victims Chen A, Chen B, Wu, and others—15 people in total—surrounded Jiang. Chen A stepped forward to choke Jiang’s neck, knocked him to the ground, straddled him, and beat him. Sun, Hu, Zhang, and others joined in kicking and beating him. While being beaten by the group, Jiang pulled out the folding knife and swung it wildly, stabbing Chen A in the lower back and cutting Wu on the thigh. After about one minute of continuous beating, the group dispersed. Jiang got up from the ground and sat down against the low wall of a squatting toilet cubicle. Chen B, who was standing behind Jiang, slapped him, causing Jiang to turn and stab Chen B in the abdomen with the folding knife. Zhang and others beat Jiang again before leaving. Subsequently, Chen A, Chen B, and Wu were sent to the school clinic for treatment. Forensic examination determined that Chen A and Chen B suffered serious injuries Level 2, and Wu suffered minor injury. On August 7 of the same year, Jiang voluntarily surrendered to the public security authorities.

The People’s Procuratorate of Jishou City, Hunan Province, charged the defendant Jiang with intentional injury and initiated a public prosecution before the People’s Court of Jishou City, Hunan Province. The defendant Jiang and his defense counsel argued that Jiang’s act of causing harm to the unlawful infringers while defending himself against student bullying constituted justifiable defense and that he should not bear criminal liability according to law.

Judgment

The People’s Court of Jishou City, Hunan Province, rendered a criminal judgment on July 6, 2020, finding that the defendant Jiang’s conduct constituted justifiable defense and acquitting Jiang. After the judgment was pronounced, the People’s Procuratorate of Jishou City, Hunan Province, filed a protest. During the second instance, the People’s Procuratorate of Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture, Hunan Province, applied to withdraw the protest. The Xiangxi Tujia and Miao Autonomous Prefecture Intermediate People’s Court, Hunan Province, issued a criminal ruling on November 9, 2022, granting the withdrawal of the protest.

Reasoning

The defendant Jiang, having suffered student bullying from multiple students, carried a folding knife and was forced to go to the scene. When faced with a beating by multiple people, he fought back with a knife. Considering the overall circumstances of the case, his conduct should be determined to constitute justifiable defense, and he shall bear no criminal liability.

First, Jiang was forced to fight back when subjected to student bullying, and he had defensive intent. Faced with bullying by Sun and others, Jiang was clearly in a state of coercion. Although Jiang had words showing no weakness in response to the bullying, this cannot be taken to mean that he actively provoked the conflict. Considering the physical and mental characteristics of minors and the specific situation Jiang was in, it cannot be concluded solely from isolated words that Jiang had the intent to fight, thereby denying his defensive intent.

Second, Jiang’s defense while being beaten satisfied the temporal condition for justifiable defense. Jiang’s two instances of fighting back with a knife both occurred within the time period when the unlawful infringement was actually taking place: (1) When surrounded by 15 people, choked, thrown to the ground, and beaten by the group, the unlawful infringement had already occurred. (2) After Jiang was knocked to the ground and beaten continuously for about one minute, although the group beating temporarily stopped, he was still slapped from behind by one of them. The unlawful infringement was clearly still in progress and had not ended. In summary, when Jiang used a tool to fight back while being beaten by a group and after being knocked down and slapped, the unlawful infringement was ongoing, satisfying the temporal condition for justifiable defense.

Finally, Jiang’s defense with a knife while being beaten did not clearly exceed the necessary limits. Jiang was forced to defend himself while being beaten. Although the unlawful infringers did not use tools and Jiang used a knife, the folding knife he used was not a controlled knife. Moreover, the opposing side numbered as many as 15 people, and the balance of power was heavily skewed. Jiang was knocked to the ground and beaten by the group twice. In the heat of the moment, Jiang used a knife to defend himself, which was reasonable under the circumstances. His counterattack was limited to resisting the unlawful infringement, not actively attacking the other side, and the means were restrained. Overall, therefore, the defensive act did not clearly exceed the necessary limits.

In addition, according to the Law on the Protection of Minors and relevant regulations, schools shall establish a system for the prevention and control of student bullying and conduct education and training on preventing student bullying for faculty, staff, and students. In the event of a student bullying incident, the bullied student and surrounding classmates shall promptly report to teachers and parents; schools shall immediately stop student bullying and handle it according to law; guardians shall strengthen discipline over students who engage in bullying and cooperate with the school and relevant authorities in handling the matter. Schools or guardians that fail to perform their duties according to law shall bear corresponding legal liability.
